name: io.iquota/hotels
title: iQuota Hotels
description: Search, quote and book independent hotels: official rates, live availability, pay at the hotel.

tools.name: search_hotels
tools.description:
Search live availability and prices of directly-contracted hotels, apartments and villas.
        destination: city, area, region, hotel name or ISO country code (not needed on a hotel's own
        connector). Dates YYYY-MM-DD. adults and
        children_ages are per room. currency: EUR, USD… (if the property sells in it). board: Room only,
        Bed & breakfast, Half board, Full board or All inclusive. Returns hotels with options; each option has
        a rate_key (valid 30 minutes) for check_rate and book_hotel, and each hotel a booking_url (its official
        page with these dates) that the traveller can open to see prices and book.

destination.description: City, area, region, hotel name or ISO country code. Leave empty on a hotel's own connector.
destination.title: Destination

children_ages.description: Age of each child per room, e.g. [4, 9].
children_ages.title: Children Ages

rooms.description: Number of rooms with the same occupancy.
rooms.title: Rooms

currency.description: ISO currency code (EUR, USD…), used if the property sells in it.
currency.title: Currency

max_total_price.description: Maximum total price for the whole stay, in the requested currency.
max_total_price.title: Max Total Price

board.description: Room only, Bed & breakfast, Half board, Full board or All inclusive.
board.title: Board

tools.name: get_hotel
tools.description:
Full details of a hotel: description, amenities, photos, location, rooms, check-in times,
        children policy and payment terms (hotel_code not needed on a hotel's own connector).

hotel_code.description: hotel_code returned by search_hotels (e.g. ES-ATL-0001). Leave empty on a hotel's own connector.
hotel_code.title: Hotel Code

tools.name: check_rate
tools.description: Re-check price and availability of an option right before booking.

rate_key.description: rate_key of an option returned by search_hotels (valid 30 minutes).
rate_key.title: Rate Key

tools.name: book_hotel
tools.description:
Confirm a booking. Only call after the traveller has explicitly confirmed the hotel, dates, room,
        total price, cancellation policy and payment terms (set traveller_confirmed=true). Payment is
        collected by the property: never ask for card details. Returns the booking reference.

rate_key.description: rate_key from search_hotels or check_rate (valid 30 minutes).
rate_key.title: Rate Key

guest_name.description: Full name of the lead guest.
guest_name.title: Guest Name

guest_email.description: Guest email; the confirmation is sent there.
guest_email.title: Guest Email

guest_phone.description: Guest phone with country code, for the property.
guest_phone.title: Guest Phone

traveller_confirmed.description: true only after the traveller explicitly confirmed hotel, dates, room, total price, cancellation policy and payment terms.
traveller_confirmed.title: Traveller Confirmed

special_requests.description: Optional requests for the property (arrival time, cot…); not guaranteed.
special_requests.title: Special Requests

tools.name: get_booking
tools.description: Look up a booking made through iQuota, using its reference and the guest email.

guest_email.description: Guest email used in the booking.
guest_email.title: Guest Email

tools.name: cancel_booking
tools.description:
Cancel a booking. First call with confirm=false to get the cancellation fee, tell the traveller,
        and only if they agree call again with confirm=true.

guest_email.description: Guest email used in the booking.
guest_email.title: Guest Email

confirm.description: false: only quote the cancellation fee; true: cancel, after the traveller agreed.
confirm.title: Confirm
